assumptions.assumption: Per-day price is AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(rental_duration) computed per rating over all films, as the request states (ratio of averages, not average of per-film ratios).

All films are included, including any with NULL rating (none expected; 5 ratings verified). The mean of per-day prices is the unweighted mean across rating groups, via a window AVG over the grouped rows.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_price, per_day_price / AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS per_day_price_ratio FROM r

assumptions.assumption: Per-day price is computed as AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) over each rating's films, as the request states (ratio of averages, not the average of per-film ratios).
All films are included, including those with no inventory copies; averages are over the film table, not weighted by inventory copies.
The 'simple mean of all ratings' is the unweighted mean of the 5 per-rating per-day prices, computed via AVG() OVER () on the grouped rows.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_price, per_day_price / AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_per_day_price FROM r ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: Per-day price is computed as AVG(rental_rate) divided by AVG(rental_duration) within each rating (ratio of averages, as the request states), not the average of per-film rate/duration.
Films with NULL rating are not present (verified data shows exactly 5 rating levels), so each rating is counted once in the simple mean via AVG over the 5 grouped rows.
